nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/rejected_sample_desktop.md — the desktop filter's discard sample, same format as the laptop one: rejected turns in full, each headed by its rule, timestamp and session file

The five desktop reject rules appearing in the sample: `tool_result` (the largest bucket at 620), `task_notification`, `command_expansion`, `is_meta` and `interrupt_marker`. No `harness_template` reject exists on this machine, which is why the desktop false-negative audit enumerates rather than samples. The discarded material includes pasted research digs and agent contracts, which is what the rules are separating out from typed human turns
